text: Web Search Advanced（DSH 网页客户端插件）：为 DSH 的 web 服务接入可配置的网页搜索提供方。插件注册 DeepSeek 搜索适配器，并在设置侧栏提供配置卡片，可选择 DeepSeek 原生搜索或 OpenAI 兼容的自定义搜索服务。用户可以设置服务地址、模型、API Key 和结果数量，并在保存前测试连接；搜索结果会整理为链接、标题、摘要等来源信息。适合需要在 DSH 网页会话中搜索网络资料并切换搜索服务的用户。使用时需要所选服务对应的 API Key，搜索请求会发送到所配置的服务。

Web Search Advanced adds DeepSeek or custom OpenAI-compatible search to DSH. Its Settings card configures provider, endpoint, model, API key, and result limit, and tests the connection. Results include source links, titles, and snippets. A key is required; queries go to the selected service.
想让 DSH 在网页会话里搜索网络资料。
我希望能在 DeepSeek 搜索和自定义 OpenAI 兼容搜索之间切换。
Add web search to my DSH web sessions.
Web Search Advanced 的功能「双提供方搜索」：DSH 可用 DeepSeek 原生搜索或自定义 OpenAI 兼容服务执行网页搜索，并将结果整理为来源链接、标题和摘要。
Web Search Advanced 的功能「搜索设置与连接测试」：在 DSH 网页端的设置卡片选择提供方、编辑 API Key、模型、服务地址和结果数量，并可测试当前配置；保存前也会执行连接检查。
Web Search Advanced 使用前须知：搜索查询发送到所选服务，并需要对应 API Key；默认凭据引用为 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY。默认服务地址是 api.deepseek.com 或 openrouter.ai。

@lp181818/web-search-advanced README · @lp181818/web-search-advanced：Advanced web search plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), supporting both native
DeepSeek search and OpenAI-compatible "Custom" search providers.

@lp181818/web-search-advanced README · Features：- Provider selector: `deepseek` (native) or `custom` (OpenAI-compatible, e.g. OpenRouter)
- Settings section: provider choice, endpoint URL, model, API key, max searches
- Two search backends: native DeepSeek `web_search_20250305` or an OpenAI-compatible web plugin
- **Automatic retry (v0.1.4)**: transient failures (HTTP 429 / 5xx / network
  errors) are retried with exponential backoff, honoring the server
  `Retry-After` header (configurable `maxRetries`, default 3)
- **Test before save (v0.1.4)**: the settings card probes the configured
  endpoint (`/chat/completions` for Custom, `/messages` for DeepSeek) with the
  current draft values before saving; real config errors (bad endpoint/model/key)
  block the save, transient 429/5xx only warn

@lp181818/web-search-advanced README · DSH compatibility：| DSH version | Compatibility |
| --- | --- |
| `0.1.7-rc.2` | Verified on this machine: host half exports a `Config` schema with `.volatile()` fields; browser half binds the settings form through the `configForms` service |
| `0.1.2-rc.1` and current 0.1.2 rc | Still uses the legacy `settings.register`/`settingsScope` API; theoretically compatible, verify before claiming |
| `0.1.0-rc.7` through pre-0.1.2-alpha | Uses the shared `settings.register`/`installSection` service API; theoretically compatible |
| before `0.1.0-rc.7` / 0.0.x | Not supported; those DSH versions lack the settings/section mechanism |

@lp181818/web-search-advanced README · DSH compatibility：The current source no longer imports the removed `settingsNamespace`,
`installSettingsSection`, or `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime` APIs.
Since `v0.2.0` it also no longer uses the `settings.register` /
`settingsScope` APIs removed in DSH `0.1.7-rc.2`; the settings namespace is
the plugin's exported `Config` schema (entry id `web-search-advanced`), and
saving hot-reloads the plugin fiber with the fresh config.

@lp181818/web-search-advanced README · Enabling this provider in DSH：Installing this package automatically routes the DSH `web` service to
`web-search-advanced`; no manual `cordis.patch.yml` edit is required. After
installation, restart `dsh web` and configure the package in the Web Search
settings section.

@lp181818/web-search-advanced README · Enabling this provider in DSH：Only the provider, API key, and model are required. The endpoint is optional:
DeepSeek uses `https://api.deepseek.com/anthropic/v1`, while Custom uses
`https://openrouter.ai/api/v1` when the endpoint is left blank. Inside the
`web-search-advanced` settings namespace:

@lp181818/web-search-advanced README · Enabling this provider in DSH：- `searchProvider: deepseek` uses this plugin's DeepSeek branch.
- `searchProvider: custom` uses the configured OpenAI-compatible
  `baseURL` / `model`, for example OpenRouter.
- `maxRetries: 3` (optional) — exponential-backoff retries for transient
  failures (429 / 5xx / network), default 3.

Settings persist in `~/.dsh/settings.yaml` under the `web-search-advanced`
namespace and survive DSH restarts until deleted.

@lp181818/web-search-advanced README · Enabling this provider in DSH：The package patch also selects the built-in `http` fetch provider so search
results can be opened without an additional profile change.

@lp181818/web-search-advanced README · Build：This repository includes the prebuilt `lib/` artifacts required by DSH skill
hub validation. Direct GitHub installs also have a `prepare` script that can
rebuild them.

DSH resolves `@deepseek-ai/*` packages as runtime peers, so local installs
should not make npm resolve them:

```powershell
npm install --legacy-peer-deps
npm run build
```

Build output:

- `lib/index.js` - DSH host/plugin half
- `lib/client.js` - DSH web client bundle

After a build, sync into an installed DSH profile:

@lp181818/web-search-advanced README · Build：```powershell
npm run sync
```

If no profile has the package installed yet, install it first:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add github:bug-huntter/web-search-advanced
```

Then restart DSH and apply the profile patch:

```powershell
dsh web
```

The plugin registers its provider through `ctx.web`, registers the
`web-search-advanced` settings namespace, and exposes that namespace to the
web client through the configurable-provider registry.
